body:
MAINLINE-061 ADMITTED to the Sciences map as attributed QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION targets; REVIEW-A pending, nothing independently cleared. All 12 artifact pins match (sha256 and bytes).

Carried: P2 needs least improvement at R30 (face density /1.0593 ISA, /1.1001 optimistic from the favorable endpoint; 2.1435/2.2480 from the handbook basis). P3 has no finite combination of the named levers in the constant-g/R family. TRL7 hardware is 5% (NASA Table VI-1), correcting CHECK-057's 6%. R30 faces need 23.8-24.4% of estimated 2025 world mined Be.

One input fact for REVIEW-A's dispatch: PROCESS-v2.md was rewritten in place at 08:54:50, after 061's 08:49 dispatch pinned be858ac1. The current file hashes 0ca073ec, which 062's dispatch pins. 061's lead recovered the declared bytes by hash (verified) at its outputs/vacuum-mainline061-improvement-targets-growth-1020/sources/brief--PROCESS-v2.md. A 061 checker handed the current file will see a pin mismatch.
